name: Divorce And Remarriage
overview: Scripture presents marriage as a sacred union where a man and woman become one flesh, as established in Genesis 2:24. While Deuteronomy 24:1 allows for divorce under certain circumstances, Malachi 2:16 reveals God's hatred for putting away a spouse, emphasizing faithfulness and integrity. In the New Testament, Jesus teaches in Matthew 5:31-32 and 19:9 that divorce is permissible only on the grounds of sexual immorality, warning that remarriage after divorce outside this cause constitutes adultery. These passages affirm the sanctity of marriage and set clear boundaries for divorce and remarriage within God's design.
